decision: SPEC-P7 D9 (owner approved 28/11/2026); D13: P6 NumPy workload, no PyTorch, no real RAG

workload.success_marker: Job Complete and final checkpoint object in the run bucket (same checks as P6)
workload.input_size: fixed by the image (synthetic NumPy data); no external dataset

capacity.baseline_arm: On-Demand, one node created by owner CLI (D7), label zero-drift.io/role=baseline
capacity.optimized_arm: Karpenter batch pools, Spot first, On-Demand fallback reported separately
capacity.zone: observed and recorded; a difference between arms is reported, not hidden
capacity.root_volume: gp3 20 GiB encrypted, deleted with the instance (EC2NodeClass batch)

ordering: pairs alternate baseline->optimized and optimized->baseline when feasible
change_rule: any change makes batch-cpu-small-v2; pairs of different profiles are never pooled
